snippet.title: Hold On - Official Teaser Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Struggle. Fall. Triumph. Hold on. A small yet grand journey across life. Simple interactions connect seemingly unrelated moments, from the microscopic to the cosmic. Check out the Hold On teaser trailer for this upcoming interactive experience by Brian S. Chung & GJ Lee. Hold On will be available on PC and Mac in 2027.
